name: catalyst_r2e_lambdarank_production_v1
scope: external general_merged R2E direct queries without seeds, masks, candidate subsets, taxonomy restriction, temporary candidates, or manual model override
fallback: All ineligible scopes preserve the existing v3 similarity-router / historical task-specific routes.

functional: ranker SHA256 and config must equal the confirmed frozen artifacts
primary/secondary protein candidate IDs must be exactly aligned
candidate route must reproduce the frozen two-stage Top-100 union/prefix semantics
no CAGE rescue may alter the learned-fusion ordering inside its confirmed scope
runtime_gate.steady_state_latency: median <= 2.2x and p95 <= 2.5x the current v3 router on the same fixed label-blind query set after both routes are warm
runtime_gate.memory: no OOM; incremental resident memory <= 1.5 GiB and incremental GPU memory <= 2.0 GiB versus the warmed current v3 router
runtime_gate.promotion: Only after all functional and runtime gates pass may the candidate manifest replace the default route manifest; confirmation metrics are not revisited for runtime tuning.
